audit.whatIsWrong: The page is built around an ability called 'Repeating Dashes'. Ambessa has no such ability. It is the focus target, the loading-screen track line, the cooldown block, and roughly twenty other strings. Separately, the content layer calls her W 'Repudiation dashes' — Repudiation is not a dash at all.
audit.why: Riot's kit lists Drakehound's Step (P), Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam (Q), Repudiation (W), Lacerate (E), Public Execution (R). The dashes come from Drakehound's Step, which fires after an ability cast. Repudiation is a shield-and-brace that then slams, and per Riot's own text it deals INCREASED damage if it blocked non-minion damage while bracing — so hitting her during the brace makes her hit you harder. It also grounds: your Harsh Lesson is a dash on a 4s cooldown, and Repudiation takes it away for 18/17/16/15/14s. That grounding is the interaction that decides the lane and it appears nowhere on the page.
audit.corrected: Focus target moved to Repudiation, the dash correctly attributed to Drakehound's Step, the grounding-vs-Harsh-Lesson rule and the do-not-hit-the-brace rule both stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] says 'Skill at 6' and whys[5] gives first item to Illaoi, but both rows are set to Ambessa in both layers.
audit.why: The mirror audit (ambessa__illaoi) already fixed that chart to Ambessa/Ambessa/Illaoi/Illaoi/Ambessa/Ambessa/Ambessa, which is what the side and win fields here already hold. Rather than fight the mirror I left the rows alone and rewrote the two whys that disagreed with them, so the page stops rendering 'Ambessa wins Level 6' beside text saying it is even.
audit.corrected: Sides untouched (mirror-consistent); whys[4] and whys[5] rewritten to Ambessa's side with real numbers — Public Execution at 130s and Repudiation's shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every phase why was template filler pointing at the fabricated ability, so no stage had a real spike attached.
audit.why: Her spikes are Repudiation coming online, level 6 (Public Execution, 130s at rank 1) and her first item. Yours is levels 3-5, where Harsh Lesson's flat 4s cooldown lets you re-slam the spirit faster than Lacerate (13s at rank 1) recovers.
audit.corrected: Phases 1 through 6 rewritten with those cooldowns named.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells you what to do about her mobility beyond 'E her when her dashes are down'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Test of Spirit says the target becomes a Vessel if it gets too far from the spirit. Against the most mobile champion in the matchup list, her escape is what converts her into a tentacle farm — that is the answer to her kit, and it was never written down.
audit.corrected: Stated in spikes[2] and the late block: dash away from the spirit and she becomes a Vessel.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ambessa is called 'he' and 'him' in tradeGood, the trading breakdown, the report, the feeding block and the item block.
audit.why: Template text stamped in without a gender pass.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed in place at the same length.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' was a fabricated ability name used as this matchup's focus target and repeated through roughly twenty strings; it is now Repudiation (the real matchup-defining cooldown) or Drakehound's Step (the real dash) depending on which the sentence meant. Per the description-beats-flag rule I did not use the 'grounding' or 'untargetable' flags on Illaoi's Leap of Faith — Riot's text is damage plus a tentacle per champion hit and nothing more; the mirror audit reached the same conclusion and flagged the corresponding _missing-interactions entry as derived from that bad flag. Ambessa's Repudiation grounding IS real (it is in her own flags and matches her brace-and-slam text), so I used it.
